name: Fetch a surveil land at their end step
intent: At the opponent's end step, crack a fetch for a surveil land, Hedge Maze first, then Thundering Falls, then Commercial District, and surveil a creature or a land into the graveyard so either Living End returns the creature or a redundant land stops clogging draws; once I am flooding with four lands or more out, a land goes too. The cascade spells cost three and the deck runs sixteen lands to cast one on turn three, so a fourth land covers a cascade spell with a cycle beside it and a land past it is a dead draw. Deliberately keeps binning EVERY creature here, not just mana value 4 or more (unlike open-land-idle's and fetch-surveil-land-keep's own surveil answers): the DSL's own to_graveyard select is one flat AND match, so 'bin any land' and 'bin only a mana-value-4-or-more creature' cannot both be expressed in the same select, and the cross-deck test_surveil_bins_a_land_at_or_above_the_flood_threshold contract (scripts/tests/test_seed_play_judgement.py) requires every land on top to be binned once flooded regardless - dropping the land half to add the creature threshold here would break that shared invariant. Once genuinely flooded, discarding a small utility creature too costs nothing anyway (there is no shortage of lands left to protect). Below four lands fetch-surveil-land-keep runs instead, where the mana-value threshold does apply since lands are not binned there at all. Only at 6 life or more and while fewer than two surveil lands are out.
